objective: Direction 1 of the close of SHORT-AGAIN-20261126-001, taken up by the thread under the owner's standing rule: under the cap of three, by a meeting through a line of link knots, one three-knot receiver switches its way of growing at round 2d + 1 when the far end's site holds two loose distinctions. Read every sited start of four knots (599) as a receiver of senders of each site class at three steps, and the switching ones at other distances and under a cap of four. Stop at a rule that says which receivers switch, tested on starts it was not stated from, or when no four-knot receiver switches.
status: Complete 2026-11-26 (refereed: confirmed with fixes, one Block): of 646 receiver entries (645 distinct sited starts) six switch under the cap of three, the same counts, at round 2d + 1 with the two-knot sender of a five-sender panel; not, in general, on a far site holding two loose distinctions (referee: 175 of 198 such four-knot senders switch it, 4 of 144 with one); a matched construction does the same under caps of six and seven; settled by the far end's first three rounds; nothing without a cap.
title: Which receivers switch their way of growing on what is at the far end of a line, under a cap
